items.stem: Which of the following best describes "Gaining ratio"?
items.answer: The ratio in which the continuing partners acquire the share of the retiring or deceased partner.
items.markingKey: (a) Gaining ratio: The ratio in which the continuing partners acquire the share of the retiring or deceased partner.
options: The ratio in which the continuing partners acquire the share of the retiring or deceased partner.
The partners who remain in the firm after a partner retires or dies.
The withdrawal of a partner from the firm while the remaining partners continue the business.
The legal representative of a deceased partner to whom the amount due is paid.

items.stem: State one difference between sacrificing ratio and gaining ratio on the basis of formula.
items.answer: sacrificing ratio: old ratio − new ratio; gaining ratio: new ratio − old ratio
items.markingKey: 1 mark: sacrificing ratio: old ratio − new ratio; gaining ratio: new ratio − old ratio

items.stem:

options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
A is true, but R is false.
A is false, but R is true.
